result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible content and layout defects, most notably an invalid delivery price and horizontally clipped carousel content.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid or missing numeric value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee data formatting and provide a valid price or a fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable.”

issues.description: The category carousel and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are cut off at the right edge, leaving partial pills/cards visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional overflow behavior, such as a visible scroll affordance, or adjust spacing so the clipped state looks deliberate.

issues.description: The sticky bottom navigation overlaps the next popular restaurant card, obscuring part of its image/content near the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation bar.
